product_summary: Divi's Laboratories (legal name Divi's Laboratories Limited, Hyderabad) is an API / custom-synthesis manufacturer: active pharmaceutical ingredients (e.g. naproxen, dextromethorphan, gabapentin-class, contrast-media intermediates such as diatrizoic/iodinated acid derivatives), advanced drug intermediates, carotenoids/nutraceutical ingredients (beta-carotene, astaxanthin, lycopene, lutein) and carotenoid-based feed/food colourant preparations. NOTE: the company website (divislabs.com) could not be read in this session - root URL returned non-text/binary content and all product subpages returned HTTP 404; web_search backend was down (connection refused) and Wikipedia returned HTTP 429. Therefore the product list above is stated from general public knowledge of the company and is NOT corroborated by a page read in this session - treat as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until the catalogue is re-read.
comment: Industry misclassification in the declaration: the company is filed under 'Продукты питания и FMCG', but Divi's is a pharma API / custom-synthesis manufacturer (bulk drugs and intermediates), not an FMCG or food producer. Only the carotenoid/feed-colourant line touches food/feed additives, which is why 230990 (preparations of a kind used in animal feeding) can be partially justified - but it is a minor line, not the core business. Declared codes: 291899 (other carboxylic acids with oxygen function) and 292249 / 292250 (amino-acids, amino-alcohols/phenols) are plausible and partially consistent with API intermediates; 230990 is only partially consistent (feed-premix carotenoids). The core export line - heterocyclic/other organic compounds as APIs and intermediates (HS 2933/2934/2942) and carotenoids (3203/3826) - is MISSING from the declaration. No customs line was available to me in this session (registry/customs research is out of my scope), so every product-to-HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, verdict accepted_hs_corrected - recommended corrected set: 293399/293499/294200 (APIs and intermediates), 291829/291899 (carboxylic acid intermediates), 320300/382600 (carotenoids), 230990 (feed/food colourant preparations, minor). Trader signs: none observed - own manufacturing sites (Hyderabad units, Kakinada, Visakhapatnam SEZ per company communications, not re-verified this session).
